title: MCMP Two-Phase Poiseuille Flow Rate Error Fix - Honest-FAIL
objective: Fix SC MCMP two-phase Poiseuille flow rate error >20% using TensorKnowledge-guided viscous velocity coupling

method.knowledge_retrieval: Searched TensorKnowledge knowledge/oss-lbm/claims/ for MCMP velocity coupling conventions
method.hypothesis: Viscosity-weighted velocity coupling (u_eq='viscous') will enforce velocity continuity at interface and reduce flow rate error from 20-33% to <10%
method.implementation: Added u_eq='viscous' mode to collide_sc_two_component in src/tensorlbm/multiphase.py (+32 lines)

conclusion.root_cause: SC MCMP 'self' mode 20-33% flow rate error is inherent model defect: velocity discontinuity at interface (u1 ≠ u2) creates effective slip boundary, reducing flow resistance and over-predicting flow rate
conclusion.fix_failure_mechanism: Viscous coupling forces u1=u2=u_visc, but SC interaction force (maintaining interface) tries to create velocity difference. Conflict causes numerical oscillation → density overflow → divergence. When τ1≠τ2, weighted relaxation terms sum ≠ 0 (net momentum source), same instability as 'mixture' mode
conclusion.recommendation: Use Color-Gradient method (single velocity field + recoloring) which achieves 0.2% error (validated)

deliverables.source_code: src/tensorlbm/multiphase.py (+32 lines: viscous mode + stability caveat)

tests_run: 3-mode collision test (self/mixture/viscous on ny=33 step=1) — all finite PASS
5-config parameter sweep (tau=(1,1)/(1,0.75)/(1,0.9), G=-2.5/-1.0/-0.5, 3000 steps each) — viscous diverges for G=-2.5 unequal tau, stable but worse for G=-1.0
Baseline self-mode ny=33 5000 steps — finite, ratio=1.155
Report API submission: curl POST to :8010/tensor/reports — returned id=10385
Cluster job cj105 submitted then killed after divergence confirmed locally
knowledge_value: Negative result is still knowledge: excluded viscous coupling for strong SC phase separation, provided clear exclusion chain for future research
